text: You do all the tests in the browser from end to end to verify it fully works. Also, since the CMSify and eCommerceify features can be quite long, I want you to create a very fancy animation. The Sanity CMSify animation should be about detecting the boxes that will be editable and do an animation like react scan. And the CMS EFI can be a simple full screen on top of the page preview with some cards that are rotated and repeating over 45 degrees and a skeleton below it. The card should be grey with a white skeleton light below it, and the background behind the card should be black.
